name: Dolly Lewis
bio: Dolly Lewis is an American / British actress, jazz singer, and audiobook narrator, originally hailing from Princeton, New Jersey. She attended The Esper Studio and lives in New York City. Dolly sings regularly throughout the city. On camera, she can be seen as the femme fatale in The Dutchman's Pipe (2021) and is currently slated to play the lead in an upcoming feature film from director Béla Baptiste.

credits.title: The Dutchman's Pipe
credits.overview: Two detectives have been called to the mansion of Mrs. Deroche. She has gone missing and so has her 17th century heirloom: The Dutchman's Pipe. Their only suspect is the young Austrian appraiser, Peter Zenk, who has never watched the sound of music.

credits.title: Fresh Meat
credits.overview: In the back of a butcher shop, a little girl watches terrifying tales on a screen that must be fed. As its appetite grows, her father must find increasingly gruesome ways to keep the show going.

credits.title: The Obelisk
credits.overview: While fighting for survival in the wilds of the Northeast, a drifter unites with a mysterious veteran to expose the truth of America’s demise.

credits.title: What's in Your Bag?
credits.overview: In a world caught between banality and brutality, “What’s in Your Bag?” embodies our complicity in the spectacle of surveillance. It offers us a stark reflection of our willingness to look – and, perhaps, our inability to stop.

credits.title: Belleville
credits.overview: A woman's kindness toward a stranger becomes a struggle for control when he follows her into her apartment and later returns violently through the window. A phone call links past and present in this reenactment of a true story about fear, survival, resilience and forgiveness.

credits.title: Concrete Whisper
credits.overview: A medieval saga and the surreal game in a chat group gradually give shape to a creature that makes its tracks through the big city. As the plot develops, the urban environment increasingly gains significance, with social and political themes influencing the progress of the story.

credits.title: Pale as Ale
credits.overview: A New Yorker searching for the world's best beer takes a series of wrong turns through Hamburg and Vienna before reaching a happy ending in Murau.

credits.title: Percht
credits.overview: It's Christmas season in a small town somewhere in the Austrian countryside. Following tradition, the young local men parade in daemon-like masks to chase away the winter...
